term: shared-timeline presence scopes and within-world propagation
definition: For History W B T and bearer x, Worldwise means ∀w ∃t IsAt w x t; Common means ∃t ∀w IsAt w x t; AllTime means ∀w ∀t IsAt w x t. Uniform means ∀w s t, IsAt w x s → IsAt w x t. W, B and T are separate types and T is shared by all worlds. History.now provides a time even with no world or bearer inhabitants. No order or accessibility restriction is used.
note: Analyst controls for #469. The finite interpretations use Bool/Unit/Bool. Uniform is an explicit temporal restriction, not a source claim or conservation axiom; no CoherentAtNow is assumed. A source-derived eternity bridge would require its own witness and faithful meaning. Bundle locator only: Worldwise is one member entry point, not a declaration defining this entire family. Precise members are DEF-HISTORY-TIME-WORLDWISE, DEF-HISTORY-TIME-COMMON and DEF-HISTORY-TIME-ALL-TIMES, at HistoryTimeScope.Worldwise/Common/AllTime. HistoryTimeScope.Uniform is the separately supplied propagation condition. This overview is not a fourth rival scope or a synonym for Common.
